description: This file implements the VaryingPacking class, which manages the mapping of shader varyings to hardware registers, including packing algorithms and register allocation for graphics rendering pipelines.

classes.name: VaryingPacking
classes.description: Manages the packing of shader varyings into hardware registers, including algorithms for different packing modes and register allocation.

methods.name: ComparePackedVarying
methods.description: Compares two PackedVarying objects to determine packing priority based on shader variable properties.

methods.name: VaryingPacking
methods.description: Constructor initializing the VaryingPacking object with maximum varyings and packing mode.

methods.name: packVarying
methods.description: Attempts to pack a single PackedVarying into register space based on current packing mode.

methods.name: isFree
methods.description: Checks if a register block is free for packing a varying.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a PackedVarying into the register map at specified location.

methods.name: collectAndPackUserVaryings
methods.description: Collects user varyings from merged shader varyings and attempts to pack them into registers.

methods.name: packUserVaryings
methods.description: Packs a list of PackedVaryings into registers, ensuring contiguous placement.
